title: Count Commas in Range II

solution.content:
### Approach: Place Value Contribution

#### Intuition

In standard number formatting, a comma is inserted every three digits from the right (for numbers with at least four digits). Instead of counting the number of commas in each integer individually, we can look at it from another angle and calculate the "contribution" of each comma to the final answer:

- Numbers greater than or equal to $10^3$ will contain at least $1$ comma, contributing a total of $n - 10^3 + 1$ commas.

- Numbers greater than or equal to $10^6$ will contain at least $2$ commas (i.e., an additional $1$ comma per number from the previous step), contributing an additional $n - 10^6 + 1$.

- In general, each power of $1000$ ($p$) up to $n$ contributes an additional $n - p + 1$ commas. We can start at $p = 1000$, add $n - p + 1$ while $p \le n$, and multiply $p$ by $1000$ in each iteration.

#### Implementation

<iframe src="https://leetcode.com/playground/8t6okZdC/shared" frameBorder="0" width="100%" height="242" name="8t6okZdC"></iframe>

#### Complexity Analysis

- Time complexity: $O(\log n)$.

  The loop runs $O(\log_{1000} n)$ times because `p` is multiplied by $1000$ in each iteration (at most $5$ iterations for $n \le 10^{15}$).

- Space complexity: $O(1)$.

content:
You are given an integer n.

Return the total number of commas used when writing all integers from [1, n] (inclusive) in standard number formatting.

In standard formatting:

  • A comma is inserted after every three digits from the right.
  • Numbers with fewer than 4 digits contain no commas.

 

Example 1:

Input: n = 1002

Output: 3

Explanation:

The numbers "1,000", "1,001", and "1,002" each contain one comma, giving a total of 3.

Example 2:

Input: n = 998

Output: 0

Explanation:

​​​​​​​All numbers from 1 to 998 have fewer than four digits. Therefore, no commas are used.

 

Constraints:

  • 1 <= n <= 1015
hints: Count the numbers in each comma group (1-3 digits, 4-6 digits, 7-9 digits, ...) and multiply by how many commas each number in that group has.
